## Checklist

- [ ] One folder per skill, `SKILL.md` with `name` (same as the folder) and `description` (what it does and when to use it, with the phrases people would type)
- [ ] Written in English
- [ ] Scripts only import from inside the skill folder and need no install step (or the `SKILL.md` says how)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, passwords, personal paths or private server data
- [ ] No code or detailed analysis of paid or escrowed resources
- [ ] Added to the table in the root `README.md`
- [ ] I agree to license this under the repo's MIT license
